memories.title: Order renderer regression after rollout
memories.summary: Order renderer 500 errors, one-second delay, and liveness failures after v2 rollout.
memories.rootCause: Bad deployment introduced an order renderer exception and slow rendering path.
memories.remediation: Roll back the renderer deployment to the previous healthy version.

verification: Verify /api/orders error rate and latency return to baseline.
Check the independent database incident before a whole-deployment rollback.

memories.title: Worker heap leak and simulated OOM
memories.summary: Worker heap leak and simulated OOM: HighMemory, PodOOMKilled, PodRestarts, High5xx on memory-worker.
memories.rootCause: A retained-object memory leak exhausted the worker heap and caused OOM termination.
memories.remediation: Roll back the leaking build, release retained objects and verify memory stabilizes before restoring capacity.

verification: Verify memory-worker errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Runaway compute loop saturates CPU
memories.summary: Runaway compute loop saturates CPU: HighCPU, HighLatency, High5xx on compute-worker.
memories.rootCause: A runaway compute loop saturated CPU independently of request volume.
memories.remediation: Disable the runaway computation and cap worker concurrency; verify CPU and latency return to baseline.

verification: Verify compute-worker errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: orders-db pool exhaustion
memories.summary: Independent database connection probe reported 503 and slow connection acquisition while renderer behavior was independent.
memories.rootCause: Database connection pool exhaustion prevented acquiring orders-db connections.
memories.remediation: Restore the connection pool by releasing leaked connections and resizing its capacity; verify the independent renderer stays healthy.

verification: Verify orders-db acquisition errors and latency return to baseline.
Verify the order renderer is unaffected.

memories.title: Payments dependency is unavailable
memories.summary: Payments dependency is unavailable: DependencyErrors, High5xx, HighLatency on payments-client.
memories.rootCause: The payments downstream dependency was unavailable and rejected connections.
memories.remediation: Restore the payments dependency, use a circuit breaker and contain retries until the dependency recovers.

verification: Verify payments-client errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Traffic surge overloads ingress capacity
memories.summary: Traffic surge overloads ingress capacity: HighRPS, HighCPU, HighLatency, High5xx on ingress-worker.
memories.rootCause: A traffic spike exceeded ingress processing capacity and overloaded its queue.
memories.remediation: Rate limit excess traffic and scale ingress capacity after verifying demand and resource limits.

verification: Verify ingress-worker errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Worker startup configuration crash loop
memories.summary: Worker startup configuration crash loop: PodCrashLooping, LowAvailableReplicas, High5xx on startup-worker.
memories.rootCause: A missing required startup configuration caused repeated process exits and CrashLoopBackOff.
memories.remediation: Restore the required startup configuration and verify the worker reaches readiness without repeated exits.

verification: Verify startup-worker errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Deployment image pull prevents rollout
memories.summary: Deployment image pull prevents rollout: DeploymentUnavailable, LowReplicas, PodRestarts on rollout-controller.
memories.rootCause: An invalid image tag produced ImagePullBackOff and prevented the deployment rollout.
memories.remediation: Correct the image tag or roll back to the last available image; verify the rollout and available replicas.

verification: Verify rollout-controller errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Storage volume exhausted by retained logs
memories.summary: Storage volume exhausted by retained logs: DiskAlmostFull, WriteErrors, HighLatency on storage-writer.
memories.rootCause: Retained logs filled the storage volume and caused ENOSPC write failures.
memories.remediation: Rotate and remove safely disposable logs or expand the storage volume; verify successful writes and free space.

verification: Verify storage-writer errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.

memories.title: Packet loss delays shipping requests
memories.summary: Packet loss delays shipping requests: UpstreamLatency, RequestTimeouts, HighLatency on shipping-client.
memories.rootCause: Packet loss on the shipping network path caused upstream latency and request timeouts while the dependency remained healthy.
memories.remediation: Inspect and restore the shipping network path, contain retry pressure and verify packet loss and upstream latency.

verification: Verify shipping-client errors and latency return to baseline; preserve unrelated components.
